title: Ericka S NDE 4386
content: I do not remember going to the hospital or anything that entailed my arrival there. They told me afterwards that I had to be resuscitated and I remained in a coma for three days. I remember it was dark, pitch black. I am terrified of the dark in life but I had absolutely no fear. It was neither hot nor cold but I was aware of a tingle. I knew I was dead. I knew I had no body. I looked at myself and was there, but not. My son's father was there, he had committed suicide a few years before and at that time, we had been on terrible terms. All I felt from him was absolute love all I felt period was complete love and peace and knowledge like I was full. He kept telling me to go back, but it was not in words it was like telepathy or something. I kept begging to not but he kept saying I had to I did not belong here, and our son needed me. My son was kidnapped years before and I had not seen him since. I kept saying, 'I wouldn't know him if I saw him'. My ex-husband showed me a visual of him. He did not look like what I remembered. He looked like a perfect mix of his father and I. When he was little he looked exactly like his father, I did not believe him I said that isn't him. He said you will see. A figure I could not distinguish came towards me he was in a robe. I felt safe though I did not know him. He guided us toward what seemed to be something out of 'Clash Of the Titans' like a reflecting glass of sorts and pointed towards it, indicating me to watch. What I saw was like my entire life in seconds but I did not have my experiences what I experienced was the people I was dealing with feelings, like my effect on them, how I had made them feel. Kind of like without judgment but I knew how I had hurt people. I felt guilt but not really more of an understanding of my energy on people. Then my ex-husband was pushing me back telling me to go I could not stay it was not time, I begged to stay there with him. I was not allowed. He said this was not the place for me. I must go back and make things right.

I knew I had no body.” “All I felt period was complete love and peace and knowledge like I was full.” “He kept telling me to go back, but it was not in words it was like telepathy or something.” “It was not time.” “I must go back and make things right.”
